curatorial_rationale: International Light and Space recognition; a strong anchor for serious contemporary collectors. Taos studio/artist identity is linked from his own site.
sourcing_limitations: Prices and sale availability are not published for the six selected 2023–24 gallery records. These are inquiry leads, not confirmed stock. Newer public installations are not sale inventory.

curatorial_rationale: Taos-associated Light and Space artist, born 1943; institutional context is supported by a LACMA collection record.
sourcing_limitations: Recent 2026/2025 gallery-published works are preferable to importing museum objects or sold works. Charlotte Jackson is in Santa Fe; it is a source/seller, not a Taos gallery target. Do not confuse Cooper with the photographer of the same name.

curatorial_rationale: Recognized painter/teacher with an artist-operated Taos studio and an active published portfolio.
sourcing_limitations: Six records are marked Available on his own site; only At Peace displays a price in these selected records. Winter Pastures routes to a San Antonio gallery. Older exhibition text does not make creation dates current.

curatorial_rationale: Long-established Taos painter; a substantial price-led painting selection gives the collector journey practical depth.
sourcing_limitations: The six highest priced results in the retrieved Chimayo price-descending category are $15,000–$18,500 and each individual page says one in stock. This establishes a published asking-price order at this seller, not the artist’s entire market or recent creation dates. Upper Ranchitos and Lower Ranchitos Fall are now sold and were excluded.

curatorial_rationale: Taos studio artist whose metalwork, mirrors and paintings add material variety and direct-studio possibilities.
sourcing_limitations: Six highest-priced individually identified works selected from the public Current Works gallery. The two Chief works share one photograph and each has its own $4,200 price. Units, years and live stock need confirmation.

curatorial_rationale: Taos painter with a distinctive figurative practice and an artist-operated current portfolio.
sourcing_limitations: The six original-work pages conflict with the By Request index: $0 placeholders and out-of-stock text. Keep all six as unavailable-to-checkout research leads. Request prices/current inventory rather than treating the placeholder as a free sale.

curatorial_rationale: Taos landscape painter and locally recognizable gallery presence, adding a different visual language and collector entry.
sourcing_limitations: Six larger-format available originals selected from his own page. Price and artwork year are unpublished; size is not proof of price. A work on hold was excluded. Preserve title spelling until the artist approves corrections.

curatorial_rationale: Taos printmaker whose woodblock work broadens price access and demonstrates a genuine original-print path.
sourcing_limitations: Five priced 2026 works plus Snowy Mountains (2025) were not marked sold in retrieved records. Three Forks Conejos and Hay Bales and Clouds were sold out/$0 and excluded. Confirm edition size, paper/image dimensions and units.

curatorial_rationale: Taos Pueblo artist; his own shop provides originals, objects, an original print edition and clearly separable reproductions.
sourcing_limitations: Select the highest-priced available variant of six available products, not six original paintings. The three painting originals behind the reproduction listings are explicitly sold. Beaded Shirt is an embossed-paper edition, #4/25; Magpie Vase is acrylic on pottery. Artist approval is required for identity and cultural/process interpretation.

curatorial_rationale: Nationally recognized figurative/still-life painter with a documented Taos connection; seller biographies and her long-term collaborator’s account provide context.
sourcing_limitations: Three Hindes listings and three ArtzLine listings provide six primary-seller work records. ArtzLine’s resale/artist-proceeds relationship is unknown and Larkspur has a 1998 exhibition history. This is a sourcing fallback, not a claim of six recent direct-artist works. The higher-priced Architecture & Peonies marketplace lead could not be reliably retrieved and is excluded.
